## Vision AI (Gemini free tier)
Inspects the Google Drive product image (or a video frame).

**Provider:** Google Gemini via n8n credential **Google Gemini account** (`googlePalmApi`).
**Model:** `gemini-3.6-flash` (vision, Google AI Studio free tier), with free-tier fallbacks if Google returns high-demand/404.

ChatGPT Pro is not used. OpenAI API is not used. No mock AI.
English only. USA, Canada, UK, Australia. No invented specs. No website URL.

To add another provider later: extend **Build Provider Payload** and **Provider Switch**.

return [{ json: { ...job, gemini_raw: $json } }];

parameters.errorMessage: Unknown AI provider. The production path uses Google Gemini free tier through n8n. OpenAI API is not used. Mock AI is not used.
